mentions.name: FeedSync
mentions.description: A hosted tool that pushes RSS feed updates to Discord. It has attracted sign-ups without any marketing, is used by the author and a few friends, and is currently built with Phoenix LiveView deployed in a single region, with a SPA being explored as a lower-latency alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m still working on https://feedsync.net, a tool to push RSS feed updates to Discord.

mentions.name: FeedSync
mentions.description: An Elixir app that polls RSS feeds and pipes new entries to Discord. It is nearly ready for release with a planned free trial requiring no credit card, and the roadmap includes extending it with change detection that notifies when an HTML element on a website changes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building an Elixir app to poll RSS feeds and pipe new entries to Discord.
